annotations.text: Classes redesign — two deliverables. (1) The global Classes catalog page, restyled with DarkArcane tokens plus a new Default/Pool/Private visibility model (classes have none today — everything is visible to everyone) and a quick per-card 'Add to Campaign' subscribe action. (2) A new director-facing 'Manage Campaign Classes' screen — default classes shown as always-included, subscribed pool classes with remove, and a browse-and-subscribe grid for the rest. Mirrors the subscription model already used for Statuses (campaigns.subscribedStatusIds) but as a real dedicated workflow instead of a toggle buried in an edit form.
